items.question: Can I use 1145 Lifestyle today?
items.answer: Yes. 1145 is live as a web app at 1145.io. Use the Open 1145 Lifestyle button on its page.

items.question: Is there an app to download?
items.answer: Not yet. 1145 runs in your browser on a phone, tablet or computer. Android and iOS apps are planned, and will be listed on the Downloads page when they are released.

items.question: Where do I sign in?
items.answer: On 1145.io. This website is LSI’s company site and never asks for your 1145 sign-in or payment details.

items.question: How do I sell on 1145?
items.answer: Register as a merchant on 1145.io. Each merchant gets their own storefront, with tools for products, stock and orders.

items.question: Who do I contact about an order, a ride or a payment?
items.answer: Use the help and contact options on 1145.io, where your account and order details are available to the support team.
